Topic 4.1: Twahara (Ritual Purity) Types of Najasaat
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Twahara (Ritual Purity) Types of Najasaat, part of Devotional Acts in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: how to purify different najasaat individually/in pairs/in groups. 1. How do you purify najasaat? 2. What items do you use in removing najasaat?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
